sloka: एवम् उक्तः सुमन्त्रः तु भरतेन महात्मना ।हृष्टः सो अदिशत् सर्वम् यथा सम्दिष्टम् इष्टवत् ॥२-८२-२३॥
transliteration: evam uktaḥ sumantraḥ tu bharatena mahātmanā ।hṛṣṭaḥ so adiśat sarvam yathā samdiṣṭam iṣṭavat ॥2-82-23॥

translations.english: On hearing the words of the magnanimous Bharata, Sumantra was delighted and as instructed, ordered everything as if he was anxious to do it himself.
